html: Reconciliation of the review pass of v0.4.0, before first publication. Rubric v1.2: the indirectness flag has three values (direct, general, indirect), each cell states the studies its flag rests on, a grade never moves because a flag moved, and a High grade needs at least two cited studies with a sample size and a statistic, listed on the cell. The six C-0004 grade moves are reversed and six further High cells drop to Moderate (three for want of the numbers, two for indirect evidence on a population-sensitive property, one for a mixed cell that names no second form); 49 flags change; six criterion cells that had been graded on a reference standard the construct does not have become Absent (category error); four not-applicable cells become Absent and one Absent cell becomes not-applicable. Every Absent or Not-applicable cell names its absence type and carries no flag. Schema 0.5: indirectness_basis, absence_type, high_basis, a corresponds-with relation for single items whose only published link to an instrument is a correlation, and a generated integrity block. The site build now fails on any cell that breaks these rules. All logged as correction C-0005 with the rubric 1.1 values kept on each changed cell. No fresh literature search: as-of dates unchanged.
